title: Differential prefetch + hybrid-kernel orchestration to smooth microburst tails
creator: Alyssa Kline
description: Problem: short-lived microbursts (traffic spikes from sudden user activity) expose weaknesses in our current continuous-batching stack: single-kernel choices and naive prefill scheduling cause uneven service time distributions and p99 latency spikes during bursts. This ticket prototypes and pilots a combined approach: differential prefetching of KV/prefix data by request class, plus a hybrid kernel orchestration layer that can dynamically route parts of a batch to different optimized kernels (fused-attention vs. memory-friendly attention) depending on budget and token shape.
